name: cover
description: Full Notion-style page cover image picker — Gallery (colours/gradients/textures), Upload (inject storage), Link (URL), Unsplash (curated + live search), drag-to-reposition focal point. CoverBanner + CoverPicker + AddCoverButton. Props-driven, imports no other slice + no backend.
notes: Pure client-side slice. The upload backend + Unsplash search are INJECTED: wire onUpload to the `files` slice (useFileUpload) and searchUnsplash to a server route via unsplashSearchVia('/api/unsplash') that holds UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY server-side (never NEXT_PUBLIC). Ships a curated Unsplash fallback + Notion texture gallery so it works with zero config. resolvedUrl for upload (FileRef) covers is resolved by the host (files useFileUrl).
